skill.displayName: 搜索并播放电影，支持按类型/年份/评分筛选，中英文输入，生成 iframe 播放页面

version.changelog:
- Initial release of movie-finder skill.
- Search and filter movies by genre, year, and rating in both Chinese and English.
- Display movie posters, ratings, and plot summaries.
- Generate an HTML playback page with embedded streaming via iframe.
- Provide clickable links for multiple streaming sources.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: movie-finder
Version: 1.0.0

The skill facilitates searching for and embedding content from untrustworthy 'free streaming' domains (e.g., voodoohdee.com, vidredeem.com) into locally generated HTML files. The script `generate_movie_page.py` is vulnerable to HTML/JS injection because it lacks input sanitization when constructing the playback page using f-strings. While the intent appears to be a movie discovery tool, the instruction to embed arbitrary external URLs in iframes and the lack of security controls in the generated output pose a significant risk of serving malicious content or phishing to the user.

llm.summary: The skill does what it says (generate an embeddable movie playback page) but its runtime instructions explicitly search for and embed arbitrary third‑party streaming URLs (including sketchy/personal streaming domains) without sandboxing or host validation — this is risky and surprising for many users.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the provided code and instructions: it searches for movie metadata and generates an HTML playback page. It mentions TMDB as a metadata source but does not declare or require a TMDB API key (SKILL.md notes API key is needed if used). The scope of required resources (none) is consistent, but the SKILL.md explicitly targets many untrusted streaming sites when searching for playback URLs, which is outside a benign metadata-only task.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the agent to perform broad web searches for 'movie name streaming online free' and even explicitly target specific domains (voodoohdee.com, vidredeem.com, Moviesmi123.com). The generated HTML will embed whichever streaming_url is found directly into an iframe with no sandboxing, no host allowlist, and no validation. That means the skill routinely encourages linking to potentially infringing or malicious third‑party pages and will present them to the user as playable content.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and only one small Python script included that generates HTML from supplied parameters. Nothing is downloaded or installed at runtime by the skill bundle itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. SKILL.md notes TMDB API would require a key if used, but the package does not request or require it — the approach is to fall back to web search if no key is provided.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent or elevated platform privileges (always:false). It does not modify other skills or system-wide settings and only writes user-specified temporary HTML files when invoked.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill will generate an embeddable HTML page and embed whatever streaming URL it finds. Before installing, consider: (1) The SKILL.md explicitly targets free/unofficial streaming sites — these can be illegal and/or host malware or trackers. (2) The generated page embeds arbitrary external URLs with no sandboxing or CSP, which can expose your browser to malicious content. (3) The included Python script only formats HTML and does not fetch or validate URLs — the agent's web searches supply the URLs. Recommendations: only use trusted/official streaming sources (add an allowlist), require/offer a TMDB API key for metadata instead of scraping, add iframe sandbox attributes and Content-Security-Policy headers, validate streaming URLs (HTTPS, known hosts) before embedding, and warn users about legal/security risks of clicking unknown playback links. If you rely on this skill, review and restrict the search targets and implement URL validation and iframe sandboxing first.
